verdict.rationale: Deel documents a webhooks system delivering real-time notifications for platform events with HMAC-SHA256 signature security, supporting event-driven downstream automations instead of polling. However, the evidence pack never enumerates specific payroll lifecycle event types (e.g., payroll processed, employee onboarded, payment failed) or shows a subscription/management API for choosing event categories. Missing for 10: documented list of specific payroll/employee lifecycle event types, webhook subscription management docs, and independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability.
